requirements.title: The app encrypts sensitive data stored in private storage.
The app encrypts sensitive data stored outside of private storage.
The app stores cryptographic keys inside the platform-provided secure keystore.
The app does not hardcode sensitive data in the application package.
The app excludes sensitive data from application logs.
The app excludes sensitive data from backups.
The app properly encrypts sensitive data.
The app properly hashes sensitive data.
The app properly uses Message Authentication Codes (MACs).
The app properly generates cryptographic signatures.
The app properly verifies cryptographic signatures.
The app properly generates random numbers.
The app securely generates cryptographic keys.
The app derives cryptographic keys using approved key derivation functions.
The app rotates cryptographic keys regularly.
The app restricts access to cryptographic keys.
The app verifies that the device has a secure lock configured.
The app enforces authentication and authorization on its components.
The app enables auto-fill support for credential providers.
The app implements local authentication securely.
The app does not allow fallback to non-biometric credentials for sensitive transactions.
The app invalidates keys after any enrollment of new biometric data.
The app enforces step-up authentication before granting access to sensitive functionality.
The app makes sensitive data inaccessible after session termination.
The app ensures non-repudiation for critical actions.
The app encrypts all network traffic.
The app validates certificates for all network traffic.
The app correctly implements identity pinning.
The app securely handles deep links.
The app uses the clipboard securely and only with user consent.
The app only permits trusted app extensions to interact with it.
The app securely handles intents.
The app does not expose sensitive native functionality to WebView content.
The app only allows trusted WebView content to access local resources.
The app only allows trusted content in WebViews.
The app does not unnecessarily expose sensitive data through its user interface.
The app does not unnecessarily expose sensitive data through system notifications.
The app removes or masks sensitive data from its views when moved to the background, when being recorded or when a screenshot is taken.
The app protects its sensitive screens against overlay attacks.
The app prevents sensitive data from being exposed to, or captured by, accessibility services.
The app detects if it is running on an unsupported OS version and reacts appropriately.
The app targets the latest platform version.
The app detects if it must be updated and reacts appropriately.
The app's third-party components are regularly checked for known vulnerabilities.
The app uses the compiler-provided security features of the platform.
The app does not use deprecated APIs or functionality.
The app uses standard APIs for security-critical functionality.
The app package does not contain malicious code.
The app loads dynamic code safely from trusted sources.
The app securely handles untrusted data.
The app detects if it runs on a rooted/jailbroken device and reacts appropriately.
The app detects when it is running inside an app-virtualization environment.
The app detects when it is running in an emulated or virtual device environment.
The app implements device attestation.
The app detects attacks by malware.
The app implements app attestation.
The app verifies the integrity of its resources.
The app detects unauthorized changes to its code and execution flow at runtime.
The app implements code obfuscation.
The app applies resource obfuscation to hinder reverse engineering.
The app does not contain debug artifacts.
The app applies application-level payload encryption in addition to transport-layer encryption.
The app disables debug mechanisms.
The app detects debugger attachment at runtime and responds to protect sensitive operations.
The app detects dynamic analysis tools and responds to protect sensitive operations.
The app adequately manages permissions.
The app uses anonymization or pseudonymisation measures.
The app does not use persistent or unique identifiers in a way that enables user tracking.
The app uses privacy-preserving functionality.
The app informs the user about the privacy implications before performing an action.
The app uses adequate defaults for privacy relevant actions.
The app provides an adequate privacy policy.
The app adequately declares all user collected data.
The app adequately declares all tracking domains it connects to.
The app offers reproducible builds. (OUT OF SCOPE for the OWASP MAS EUDIW Profile)
The app provides adequate controls to manage user data.
The app provides adequate controls over the visibility of user data.
The app requests user consent prior to any data processing.
